experience_fit._comment: Experience ranges that match 4 years earn a bonus; others are penalised in score.py

evidence_blocks._comment: Factual CV blocks the tailoring module can combine. keys = theme, triggers = words in the job text that make the block relevant.

water_networks.text: Since October 2024 I have been Project Engineer on the Electricity & Water Authority's outsourced water-network maintenance contract at Budaiya Depot, Bahrain, supervising emergency repairs, leak detection and pipe replacement across the depot's service area and reinstating footpaths and roads after excavation.

boq_contracts.text: I prepare the monthly Bill of Quantities for executed works to the Water Distribution Directorate's specifications and rates and reconcile quantities with the client's inspectors before certification, so I am comfortable owning the commercial paperwork behind site work.

qaqc.text: On the airfield maintenance term contract and apron extension at Bahrain International Airport (RedX Industries) I managed inspection requests, QA/QC procedures and monthly quantity reports under live-airside constraints, coordinating closely with the client, consultant and airport operations.

roads.text: At Sayed Kadhem Aldurazi & Sons I worked on the reconstruction of Bridge 17 on Umm Al Saad Avenue for Bapco, Stage 1 grading and storm-water works for Wadi Al Buhair, asphalt works at the Al Dur IWPP and an asphalt term contract, including permits and road-closure and traffic-management plans with the authorities.

reporting.text: I produce the daily, monthly and annual operational and KPI reports for EWA management (response times, repair volumes, repeated leakages) and lead investigation reports on incidents and recurring complaints, and I build the Excel and Power Apps tools the depot uses to track them.

hse.text: I hold the NEBOSH International General Certificate and IOSH Working Safely, and I apply them daily through risk assessments, permit-to-work control and toolbox talks on live excavation and roadworks.

coordination.text: Across all my roles I have been the day-to-day link between client, consultant, subcontractors and authorities, planning materials, equipment and manpower and keeping multiple packages on programme.

software.text: I work in AutoCAD and Civil 3D for shop and as-built drawings, have STAAD Pro training, and use MS Project for programmes and Excel for quantity and progress tracking.
